Option 2: "پیر اندر خشت بیند بیش از آن - آن چه اندر آینه بیند جوان"

Translation: "The old man sees in the brick more than that - what the young sees in the mirror." This seems to be about perception differences between old and young. The old sees more in a brick (maybe deeper meaning) than the young sees in the mirror. Concept: perception, wisdom, depth of insight, difference between experience and superficiality.

Option 3: "کوله بارت را به روی کودک گریان من بگشا - چشم هایت برکه تاریک ماهی های آرامش"

Translation: "Show your burden on the crying child of mine - your eyes are a dark pond of calm fish." This seems to be about revealing burden to a child, maybe advice to share burdens? Or about empathy? The concept: empathy, sharing burden, maybe compassion.

Option 4: "جلوه آب صاف در گل و خار - چشم بگشا به گلستان و ببین"

Translation: "The appearance of clear water among flowers and thorns - open your eyes to the garden and see." This is about seeing beauty, clarity, perhaps encouraging to look at the garden (life) despite thorns. Concept: seeing beauty, clarity, perception of beauty in midst of adversity.
